Definition: from G4172 and G757; a town-officer, i.e. magistrate:--ruler of the city.
BiblicalUsage: Politarches is a ruler of the city, a town magistrate. It stands twice, in Acts 17:6 and Acts 17:8, where the Jews dragged Jason and the brethren before the rulers of the city at Thessalonica, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the rulers of the city heard the charge aright — the gospel does turn the world upside down.
